sources.title: 中国国家图书馆来源 Commons数字书目：袁树珊《命理探源》上海星相研究社1937及321幅
sources.provider: National Library of China metadata transcribed on Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: Commons records publisher 星相研究社[發行] ([上海]), 民國26[1937], title 命理探源, and 321 PDF pages; table-of-contents description is catalog derivative, not proof of its image folios. Original title/colophon/page SHA and identity to CText or other editions unbound.

sources.title: 中国国家图书馆来源 Commons数字书目：《增訂命理探原》润德书局1947及339馆目/347幅
sources.provider: National Library of China metadata transcribed on Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: Commons NLC-derived description records 民國36[1947], 潤德書局[發行者], [339] pages while PDF has 347 digital pages. No one-to-one foliation mapping; not proved same print as NCL1938 nor bound to the 1947 almanac advertisement.

sources.title: 《中華民國三十六年標準農曆通書》影像p0与p47：1947上海润德书局《增訂命理探原》三千元目录广告
sources.provider: National Library of China digital surrogate mirrored by Wikimedia Commons
sources.url: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6f/NLC416-08jh014155-38579_中華民國三十六年標準農曆通書.pdf
sources.quality_notes: Visually checked PDF original-looking source pages p0 (1947 Shanghai 潤德書局 imprint) and p47 (袁氏叢書, 增訂命理探原 三千元, 上海潤德書局 address). Proves within-book dated advertising at page scope only, not independent sale records, exact ad issue date, 1938/1947 edition identity, original PDF byte hash or physical-copy equivalence. Same digital surrogate, one witness.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: 1915 Hong Kong, 1937 Shanghai catalog, 1938 Zhenjiang, 1947 catalog and 1947 Shanghai ad have no direct plate or line-to-line copying demonstrated.
1947 contemporaneous publisher advertisement does not prove an individual copy/edition, sales, author teaching or regional master-pupil lineage.
原 and 源 coexist in NLC/NCL-derived titles; original page collation is still required.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Original-page edition collation of 1915/1937/1938/1947, title glyph, colophon and text differences
Independent evidence of Shanghai publishing and classroom transmission beyond publisher self-advertising
NLC 1947 [339] bibliographic pages versus 347 PDF image pages and exact physical copy binding
